summary_zh: 当前AI系统已经针对多个长期悬而未决的数学问题给出了解答、证伪结果和实质性进展，这引发了学界的讨论：AI的研究路径是否与数学家的研究路径一致？本研究针对11个这类数学问题，将公开的AI研究记录与人类学者的相关文献进行对比。人类文献语料库包含58篇直接对应后续AI宣称已解决、证伪或取得实质性进展的同一数学目标的论文，我们基于这些材料构建了31组同一问题下的对比样本。研究采用6种经过验证的文本度量指标，分别衡量问题解决程度、方法阐述程度、不确定性与边界定义程度、后续问题生成能力、普适性和跨学科整合程度。对比发现，AI记录更侧重解决核心问题和跨领域关联不同思路，而人类论文会投入更多精力解释方法、明确假设与局限性、提出后续研究问题，二者在普适性维度上没有检测到显著差异。逐一移除单个数学问题后，得到的估计方向仍保持不变。研究结果揭示了两种截然不同的研究特征：AI记录聚焦于完成问题求解和跨领域重组思路，而数学论文会更全面地记录研究流程、边界和研究机会，推动研究结果转化为可累积的知识。因此评估研究型AI不能仅关注其是否解决了目标问题，还需要关注其研究组织模式的特性。

title: Information Set Emulation: Causal Certificates for AI Derived EHR Features
title_zh: 信息集模拟：AI生成电子健康档案特征的因果证明
authors: Takes Fujita (VRI), Nobutaka Hattori (Department of Neurology, Juntendo University School of Medicine)
abstract: Under explicit exchangeability, positivity, and nuisance-consistency conditions, we give identification and cross-fitted augmented inverse probability weighted estimation, distinguishing empirical and population targets. An EHR compression-drift identity separates the roles of frame presence, treatment assignment, and outcome observation. Artificial simulations and a common-law finite-world example illustrate estimation failures and information-radius reduction. Synthetic Phase 0 notes demonstrate audit diagnostics; a separate role-specific analysis spread illustrates routing and is not an exact fiber radius. All experiments are synthetic. The framework specifies when reconstructed information can support a point claim and when compatible reporting is required.
summary_zh: 在明确满足可交换性、正定性和冗余一致性的条件下，本文给出了识别方案与交叉拟合增强逆概率加权估计方法，区分了经验目标与总体目标。我们提出电子健康档案（EHR）压缩漂移恒等式，分别明确了档案存在性、干预分配和结果观测三者的作用。人工模拟实验与普通法有限世界示例展示了估计失效场景与信息半径的缩减效果。合成的0期病历记录可用于演示审计诊断功能，单独的角色特异性分析表单可展示路由逻辑，并非精确的光纤半径。所有实验均为合成实验。该框架明确了重建信息何时可以支持单点声明，何时需要提供兼容的报告内容。

title: SAGE: Governed Artifact Generation from Enterprise Guidelines
title_zh: SAGE：基于企业规范的可管控工件生成
authors: Mohammadreza Sediqin, Shivali Dalmia, Sumukha Thoppanahalli, Srinivasa Karthikeya Reddy Kovvuri, Abhishek Mukherji
abstract: Enterprise guideline documents mix narrative text, complex tables, and embedded images, and converting them into structured work artifacts still takes two to three days of manual effort each. Current language and vision-language models extract from such documents but offer no governed workflow beyond extraction: no validation, no consistency checking, no traceable artifact generation. We introduce SAGE, a governed multi-stage LLM pipeline organized around a shared versioned rule store with stable identifiers, schema-validated inter-stage contracts, and end-to-end provenance tracking. Extracted rules undergo deterministic structural validation and LLM-based semantic scoring, then a consistency module that removes duplicates, flags contradictions, and surfaces specification gaps; only uncertain or flagged items reach reviewers, while high-confidence outputs are auto-approved. On 120 documents, SAGE cuts turnaround from days to 20-100 minutes, achieving a 96% document-level success rate with 3.2% hallucination, extracting 3,896 rules and producing 812 artifacts ready for human review; without governance, hallucination rises to 15.7%.
summary_zh: 企业规范文档混合了叙事文本、复杂表格和内嵌图片，将这类文档转换为结构化工作工件目前仍需要人工投入2-3天的工作量。现有的语言模型和视觉语言模型只能从这类文档中提取内容，无法提供提取之外的可管控工作流：既没有验证环节，也没有一致性检查，更无法生成可溯源的工件。本文提出SAGE，这是一个可管控的多阶段大语言模型流水线，围绕共享的带稳定标识符的版本化规则库构建，具备经过模式验证的跨阶段契约和端到端溯源追踪能力。提取得到的规则首先经过确定性结构验证和基于大语言模型的语义评分，再送入一致性模块，该模块可去除重复规则、标记矛盾内容、暴露规范缺口；只有不确定或被标记的内容才会流转给人工审核人员，高置信度的输出会直接自动通过审核。在120份文档的测试集上，SAGE将处理耗时从数天缩短至20-100分钟，文档级成功率达96%，幻觉率仅为3.2%，累计提取3896条规则，生成812份可直接提交人工审核的工件；如果去掉管控机制，幻觉率会上升至15.7%。

title: When AI Generates Covariates: Causal Typing and Estimand Drift in Sequential Experiments
title_zh: AI生成协变量时序贯实验中的因果分型与估计量漂移
authors: Takes Fujita (VRI), Nobutaka Hattori (Department of Neurology, Juntendo University School of Medicine)
abstract: Simulations show that refinement helps when it retains design-relevant information, whereas design erasure, leakage, and same-data marker selection can produce bias or undercoverage. The framework places causal semantics and claim status before confirmatory inference with generated representations.
summary_zh: 仿真实验结果表明，当特征优化过程保留与设计相关的信息时，特征细化操作可以提升效果，而设计信息擦除、信息泄露、同数据标记选择等操作则会引入偏差或导致置信区间覆盖率不足。该框架将因果语义和声明状态置于生成表示的验证性推理之前。

title: Is Luke the Author of a Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles?
title_zh: 路加是否是《路加福音》与《使徒行传》的作者？
authors: Jacques Savoy
abstract: According to Christian tradition, Luke is credited with authoring a Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles, even if his name does not appear in either book, both originally written in Koine Greek. Several biblical scholars assume that both texts were written by a common author, while others deduce the presence of two authors. Different studies have been found to support either finding, some based on qualitative evaluation, while a few others consider the occurrence frequency differences between the two books. To propose an enhanced quantitative analysis, this study is grounded on two recent authorship attribution models. The Burrows' Delta, applied with eleven different feature sizes, demonstrates common authorship. An author verification model confirms this finding. The following experiments consider several stylistic representations, feature sizes, and distance functions to confirm that Luke is the true author of both books.
summary_zh: 根据基督教传统，《路加福音》与《使徒行传》的作者都被认定为路加，尽管两本书的原文中都没有出现他的名字，且二者最初都是用通用希腊语撰写的。部分圣经学者认为两篇文本出自同一作者，也有学者推断二者由两位不同作者撰写。现有不同研究分别支持两种结论，部分研究基于定性评估，少数研究则考虑了两本书中的用词频率差异。为提出更完善的定量分析方案，本研究基于两种最新的作者归属模型开展分析：采用11种不同特征维度的Burrows' Delta方法验证了两书为同一作者所写，作者验证模型进一步确认了该结论。后续实验通过多种文体表示方法、特征维度和距离函数的验证，最终确认路加确实是这两部作品的作者。

title: Evolution of US Oral Political Language
title_zh: 美国口语政治语言的演化
authors: Jacques Savoy
abstract: The analysis of US political language is usually based on the written form (e.g. presidential addresses) or posts broadcasted on various social networks. Oral production, however, which is even more frequent, can better reveal the style and mode of thinking of the speaker. This study covers this mode of linguistic communication by considering 19 candidates from the presidential elections between 1960 to 2024. Our main research objectives are to disclose the main trends hidden in those presidential debates. Do we observe a clear simplification of the US political language over time? Does Trump have poor language compared to the other candidates? Do unusual stylistic features occur only with a single, specific president? Moreover, can we detect a pattern explaining the success or failure of some nominees? Over time, this study demonstrates a significant reduction in political language complexity, a decrease of the mean sentence length, and a noteworthy decline of complex terms. Moreover, the emotional tone increases over the decades, while logical and rational thinking tends to lessen.
summary_zh: 现有美国政治语言分析通常基于书面形式（如总统演讲）或各类社交网络发布的帖子，但使用频率更高的口语表达能够更好地展现发言者的风格与思维模式。本研究以1960年至2024年间美国总统选举的19位候选人为研究对象，覆盖口语这一语言传播形态。本研究的核心目标是揭示总统辩论中潜藏的核心趋势：美国的政治语言是否随时间推移呈现出明显的简化特征？与其他候选人相比，Trump的语言表达水平是否更低？不同寻常的风格特征是否仅出现在某一位特定总统身上？此外，我们能否识别出可解释部分候选人成败规律的模式？研究结果表明，随着时间推移，美国政治语言的复杂度显著降低，平均句长缩短，复杂术语的使用占比明显下降；同时数十年来政治语言的情感倾向不断增强，而逻辑与理性思维的占比则呈下降趋势。

title: A Systematic Evaluation of the COTQ Provincial Land Cover Product: Structural Consistency, Spectral Separability, and Relative Positioning Against ESA, ESRI, and Google Products
title_zh: COTQ省级土地覆盖产品的系统性评估：结构一致性、光谱可分性及其相对于ESA、ESRI与Google产品的定位
authors: \'Etienne Clabaut, Samuel Foucher, Yacine Bouroubi
abstract: High-resolution land use and land cover (LULC) products derived from Sentinel-2 imagery are widely used for environmental monitoring and land management, yet their performance can vary across regions with complex ecological gradients and heterogeneous surface conditions. In Quebec, these limitations motivated the development of a provincial 10-m land-cover product, the COTQ, designed to support annual monitoring of land occupation and soil artificialisation. This study presents a systematic evaluation of the COTQ product relative to three global 10-m LULC datasets: ESA WorldCover, ESRI LandCover, and Google DynamicWorld. This paper does not introduce a new mapping methodology but focuses on analysing the behaviour and consistency of the COTQ using complementary evaluation approaches. All products are harmonized under a common legend and compared using structural indicators (object-size distributions, shape complexity, Adjusted Rand Index, and Intersection over Union), spectral separability metrics derived from Sentinel-2 reflectance data, and a targeted photo-interpretation of disagreement areas. The analysis is conducted over eight Sentinel-2 tiles selected to represent the main bioclimatic domains of Qu\'ebec, from temperate and boreal forests to northern tundra environments. The results show that the COTQ exhibits structural and spectral characteristics most similar to ESA WorldCover among the reference global products, while revealing systematic differences linked to class definitions and thematic priorities, particularly for urban areas, wetlands, and rocky or cryptogamic surfaces. This multi-criteria evaluation provides an objective characterization of the COTQ product and clarifies its relative positioning with respect to existing global land-cover datasets for operational land monitoring in Qu\'ebec.
summary_zh: 基于哨兵2号（Sentinel-2）影像生成的高分辨率土地利用与土地覆盖（LULC）产品被广泛应用于环境监测与土地管理领域，但在生态梯度复杂、地表异质性强的区域，这类产品的性能往往存在明显波动。魁北克省为解决上述局限性，研发了10米分辨率的省级土地覆盖产品COTQ，旨在支撑土地占用与土壤人工化的年度监测工作。本研究针对COTQ产品开展系统性评估，选取三款全球10米LULC数据集作为参照：欧空局全球覆盖产品（ESA WorldCover）、ESRI土地覆盖产品（ESRI LandCover）与谷歌动态世界产品（Google DynamicWorld）。本文并未提出全新的制图方法，而是采用多维度互补的评估方法分析COTQ的特征与一致性：所有产品统一采用共通的分类体系，从结构指标（地物尺寸分布、形状复杂度、调整兰德指数（Adjusted Rand Index）、交并比（Intersection over Union））、基于哨兵2号反射率数据计算的光谱可分性指标，以及对不一致区域的针对性人工解译三个维度开展对比。评估范围覆盖魁北克省从温带森林、北方森林到北部苔原的主要生物气候区，共选取8景哨兵2号影像。结果表明，在所有参照全球产品中，COTQ的结构与光谱特征与ESA WorldCover最为相似，同时二者也存在由分类定义与主题优先级差异导致的系统性区别，在城市区域、湿地、岩石或隐花植物覆盖地表的分类上表现尤为明显。该多准则评估客观刻画了COTQ产品的特征，明确了其相对于现有全球土地覆盖数据集的定位，可为魁北克省的业务化土地监测工作提供支撑。

title: One Size Does Not Fit All! Dynamic Retriever and Generator Selection for RAG
title_zh: 通用方案并非最优！面向RAG的动态检索器与生成器选择
authors: Neeraj Anand, Payel Santra, Partha Basuchowdhuri, Debasis Ganguly, Sumit Bhatia
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems typically employ fixed retriever and generator configurations across queries, despite substantial differences in query complexity and information needs, leading to inefficient allocation of computational resources. While retrieval and generation adaptivity have been studied independently, their joint effect on end-to-end RAG performance remains underexplored. We systematically analyze how retriever and generator complexity interacts across factoid and multi-hop question answering (QA), including bridge and composition reasoning tasks. Our analysis shows that stronger retrieval generally yields larger gains than increased generation effort, but both exhibit diminishing and non-monotonic returns, indicating that higher-complexity configurations are not uniformly better across queries. Motivated by these findings, we introduce DRAG, a query-adaptive framework for selecting retriever-generator configurations. We first propose DRAG$_\text{QPP}$, a training-free routing approach that uses Query Performance Prediction (QPP) signals to guide retriever selection and perplexity-based measures over retrieved context to guide generator selection. We further introduce DRAG$_\text{SFT}$, a supervised routing approach that fine-tunes an LLM to jointly predict retriever-generator configurations. Across three LLM families and four QA benchmarks, \qpprag~achieves performance comparable to strong static RAG baselines while substantially reducing inference latency, whereas DRAG$_\text{SFT}$ consistently improves effectiveness over static and training-free adaptive baselines. Overall, DRAG demonstrates that jointly adapting retrieval and generation achieves a more favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off than static RAG pipelines.
summary_zh: 检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）系统通常对所有查询采用固定的检索器与生成器配置，忽略了不同查询在复杂度与信息需求上的显著差异，进而导致计算资源分配效率低下。现有研究已分别对检索自适应与生成自适应开展探索，但二者的联合作用对端到端RAG性能的影响仍缺乏充分研究。本文系统分析了事实类问答与多跳问答（包括桥接推理与组合推理任务）场景下，检索器复杂度与生成器复杂度的交互规律。分析结果显示，提升检索能力带来的性能增益通常高于提升生成能力，但二者均呈现出收益递减与非单调特征，说明高复杂度配置并非对所有查询都能带来更优效果。基于上述发现，本文提出DRAG这一查询自适应框架，用于动态选择检索器-生成器配置：首先提出无训练路由方案DRAG_QPP，利用查询性能预测（Query Performance Prediction, QPP）信号指导检索器选择，基于检索上下文的困惑度指标指导生成器选择；进一步提出监督路由方案DRAG_SFT，通过微调大语言模型实现检索器-生成器配置的联合预测。在3个大语言模型系列与4个问答基准数据集上的实验结果表明，DRAG_QPP可达到与高性能静态RAG基线相当的性能，同时大幅降低推理延迟；DRAG_SFT则在有效性上持续优于静态方案与无训练自适应基线。总体而言，DRAG证明了联合自适应调整检索与生成环节，能够比静态RAG流水线实现更优的有效性-效率权衡。

title: Confidence Comes from Experience: Experiential Confidence Estimation from Reasoning to Agents
title_zh: 信心源自经验：从推理到智能体的经验型置信度估计
authors: Caiqi Zhang, Xiaochen Zhu, Chengzu Li, Yulong Chen, Dharshan Kumaran, Nigel Collier
abstract: Reliable confidence estimation is increasingly central to the trustworthy deployment of language models: a calibrated estimate of the probability that an output is correct decides what to ship, what to escalate, and what to retry. Existing confidence estimators, however, share one design premise: they only read the current inference process, either by introspecting on it, scoring its token probabilities, or resampling it. We argue that the current inference is not a sufficient basis for confidence. We propose XConf (eXperiential Confidence): estimating confidence together with the model's accumulated experience. The experience is stored as a record of the model's own graded past episodes, each holding the task, the model's reflection, its stated confidence, the outcome, and a lesson written once the grade arrived. Given a new task, XConf's Recall stage retrieves past episodes on similar tasks met with a similar stated confidence, and reads off their historical success rate; its Reflect stage shows the model this record, has it name its recurring failure mode, and restate a confidence now informed by its own track records. Our estimator is format-general, requiring no logit access or weight updates, and costs only one answer generation. Across nine benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, multimodal QA, and interactive agents, and four models from three families, XConf beats or matches ten-sample self-consistency in discrimination (AUROC) on 23 of 24 comparisons, with much lower calibration error (ECE), at a tenth of the generation cost. Used for selective prediction, abstaining on the 10% least-confident episodes raises the delivered success rate by up to 8.7 points on agent tasks. We therefore see experiential confidence estimation as a new paradigm for future general-purpose confidence estimation.
summary_zh: 可靠的置信度估计是大语言模型可信部署的核心基础：对输出正确性概率的校准估计，决定了哪些结果可直接交付、哪些需要人工升级处理、哪些需要重试。但现有置信度估计方法都遵循同一设计前提：仅基于当前推理过程计算置信度，具体实现包括对推理过程做内省分析、对输出token的概率打分、对推理过程重采样等。本文指出仅依靠当前推理过程不足以支撑准确的置信度估计，进而提出XConf（经验型置信度估计框架），结合模型积累的历史经验完成置信度计算。经验数据存储为模型过往分级任务片段的记录，每条记录包含任务内容、模型的反思内容、模型当时给出的置信度、任务结果，以及任务分级完成后生成的经验总结。面对新任务时，XConf的召回阶段会检索过往相似任务、且模型当时给出的置信度相近的历史片段，读取这类任务的历史成功率；反思阶段将该历史记录反馈给模型，让模型归纳自身反复出现的失败模式，结合自身历史表现重新输出校准后的置信度。本文提出的估计器适配各类格式，不需要访问模型logit输出，也不需要更新模型权重，仅需额外生成一次回答即可完成计算。在覆盖推理、代码生成、多模态问答、交互式智能体的9个基准数据集上，对3个系列共4款模型的测试结果显示，在24组对比中，XConf的判别性能（AUROC）在23组上持平或优于10次采样自一致性方法，同时校准误差（ECE）远低于后者，生成成本仅为其十分之一。将XConf用于选择性预测，对置信度最低的10%任务选择弃权时，智能体任务的整体成功率最高可提升8.7个百分点。由此可见，经验型置信度估计是面向未来通用置信度估计的全新范式。

title: NeMo Data Designer: An Extensible Framework for Multimodal Synthetic Data Generation
title_zh: NeMo Data Designer：面向多模态合成数据生成的可扩展框架
authors: Johnny Greco, Nabin Mulepati, Andre Manoel, Eric Tramel, Kirit Thadaka, Mike Knepper, Dhruv Nathawani, Dane Corneil, Yev Meyer, Alex Watson, Maarten Van Segbroeck
abstract: We present NeMo Data Designer (NDD), an open-source, general-purpose framework for multi-modal synthetic data generation (SDG). Designed to be intuitive to use, NDD provides a declarative configuration format in which human and/or agent users define each dataset column, with column types spanning text, code, structured outputs, images, embeddings, and statistical samplers that are explicitly configured to steer dataset diversity. Additional column types and functionality can be introduced using the framework's flexible plugin system. NDD's configuration is an inspectable artifact, supporting workflow sharing and reproducibility. SDG is an inherently iterative process. NDD therefore builds a preview-and-revision loop into its core workflow, allowing users to generate and inspect a small number of records, refine the specification, and rerun generation at full scale. At runtime, NDD resolves dependencies, schedules calls to user-provided model endpoints, and retries failed requests. We describe NDD's architecture and programming model and present case studies spanning structured, agentic, multimodal, and domain-specialized tasks, including datasets used in Nemotron model development and in production enterprise deployments.
summary_zh: 本文提出NeMo Data Designer（NDD）这一开源通用多模态合成数据生成（Synthetic Data Generation, SDG）框架。NDD设计为易用型框架，提供声明式配置格式，支持人类用户或智能体用户自定义数据集的每一列，列类型覆盖文本、代码、结构化输出、图像、嵌入向量，以及用于调控数据集多样性的统计采样器，用户还可通过框架的灵活插件系统扩展新增列类型与功能。NDD的配置文件为可检查产物，支持工作流共享与结果可复现。合成数据生成本质是迭代式过程，因此NDD在核心工作流中内置了预览-修订循环，允许用户先生成少量记录检查效果，调整配置后再启动全量生成。运行时NDD可自动解析依赖关系、调度调用用户提供的模型端点、对失败请求执行重试。本文介绍了NDD的架构与编程模型，同时展示了覆盖结构化任务、智能体任务、多模态任务、领域专属任务的多个案例，相关数据集已应用于Nemotron模型开发与企业级生产部署场景。

title: GVD: Governed Versioning and Deduplication for Document Repositories
title_zh: GVD：面向文档库的可管控版本管理与去重框架
authors: Mohammadreza Sediqin, Shivali Dalmia, Sumukha Thoppanahalli, Abhishek Mukherji
abstract: Document repositories evolve continuously. Guidelines and policies are revised, superseded, and re-uploaded, so the same content recurs in different wording and newer versions refine or contradict earlier ones. These inconsistencies belong to the growing collection rather than to any single document, yet existing work treats versioning, duplicate detection, and contradiction detection as isolated pairwise tasks and stops once a pair is labeled. We present GVD (Governed Versioning and Deduplication), a framework that unifies cross-document version linking with rule-level conflict resolution under an auditable update policy. Incoming documents are assigned to version families through bidirectional rule alignment, and their rules are compared against the family memory to identify duplicates, contradictions, asymmetric refinements, and new knowledge, with Counterfactual Span Probing (CSP) resolving related pairs that inference misclassifies as neutral. Relation-specific policies suppress duplicates and escalate only consequential changes for review, retaining version lineage as an audit trail. The pipeline runs fully locally, with no large language model. On 120 enterprise documents processed as 140 ingestions across 59 version families, GVD reaches an F1 of 0.97 for version-family construction and 0.94 for rule-level consistency, with CSP raising rule consistency from 0.90 to 0.94.
summary_zh: 文档库处于持续演化状态：各类指南与政策会不断修订、替换、重新上传，相同内容会以不同表述形式重复出现，新版本也会对旧版本内容进行更新甚至矛盾化调整。这类不一致性属于整个文档集合的特征，而非单篇文档的问题，但现有研究将版本管理、重复检测、矛盾检测视为相互独立的成对任务，完成成对标注后就停止处理。本文提出GVD（可管控版本管理与去重框架），在可审计的更新策略下实现跨文档版本关联与规则级冲突消解的统一。新接入的文档通过双向规则对齐分配到对应版本族中，将其规则与版本族的历史记录对比，识别重复内容、矛盾内容、非对称更新内容与新增知识，同时通过反事实跨度探测（Counterfactual Span Probing, CSP）解决被推理误分类为无关联的相关内容对。框架通过关系专属策略屏蔽重复内容，仅将有实际影响的变更提交人工审核，同时保留版本谱系作为审计轨迹。该流水线可完全本地运行，无需调用大语言模型。在包含59个版本族、140次文档接入操作的120份企业文档数据集上，GVD的版本族构建F1值达到0.97，规则级一致性检测F1值达到0.94，其中CSP模块将规则一致性检测的F1值从0.90提升至0.94。

title: GraphEcho: Structural Redundancy and Evidence Provenance in LLM Graph Agents
title_zh: GraphEcho：大语言模型图智能体中的结构冗余与证据溯源
authors: Sikun Wang, Yixi Zhou, Lei Fan, Fan Zhang
abstract: A large language model (LLM) agent can follow more graph paths without acquiring more independent evidence. GraphEcho tests whether agents mistake these repeated encounters for additional corroboration. The benchmark varies path counts and evidential origins while holding evidence content fixed, and evaluates both judgments and active exploration. Controlled synthetic experiments reveal model-dependent judgment shifts, but redundant supporting paths increase the share of repeated walks across all evaluated frozen agents. Provenance-aware post-training (PAPT) reduces revisits and improves synthetic accuracy, yet covers fewer distinct sources. On scientific claims, it continues to reduce repetition while accuracy declines. These findings expose a gap between efficient exploration and effective evidence use: an agent can learn to stop repeating itself while overlooking information it needs. GraphEcho provides a controlled way to evaluate both what graph agents conclude and whether their exploration reaches distinct evidential sources.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在图结构中探索时，即便没有获取更多独立证据，也能遍历更多图路径。GraphEcho框架用于测试智能体是否会将这类重复遇到的内容误判为额外的佐证信息。该基准在保持证据内容固定的前提下调整路径数量与证据来源，同时评估智能体的判断结果与主动探索行为。受控合成实验结果显示，不同模型的判断偏移存在差异，但冗余的支持性路径会提升所有测试静态智能体的重复遍历占比。具备溯源感知能力的后训练方法（Provenance-aware post-training, PAPT）可降低智能体的重复访问占比、提升合成任务准确率，但也会导致智能体访问的独立证据来源数量减少。在科学声明验证任务上，该方法在降低重复遍历的同时伴随准确率下降。上述发现揭示了高效探索与有效证据利用之间的矛盾：智能体可以学会避免重复遍历，但也可能因此遗漏所需的关键信息。GraphEcho提供了一套受控评估方案，可同时评估图智能体的推理结论与探索过程是否覆盖了不同的独立证据来源。

title: Accelerating Diffusion Sampling via Speculative Draft Trees
title_zh: 基于推测草稿树的扩散采样加速方法
authors: Marcello Bullo, Yanxiao Liu, \"Oyk\"u S{\i}la G\"uner, Arpan Mukherjee, Deniz G\"und\"uz
abstract: Speculative sampling accelerates diffusion model generation by drafting inexpensive candidate states and correcting them under a coupling that preserves the target distribution exactly, reducing the number of expensive target evaluations. Existing diffusion samplers, notably those based on reflection maximal coupling, are topologically constrained: their lookahead drafts form a chain graph, a single linear sequence, which inherently limits the acceptance rate per target evaluation. We connect speculative sampling in diffusion models to relative entropy coding (REC). This perspective shows the lookahead need not be linear and motivates our central contribution, draft trees, which enrich the candidates considered per round and lower the target function evaluations. We further adopt greedy rejection sampling, an REC algorithm, as the draft-target coupling, improving acceptance while guaranteeing exact target samples. Experiments across diverse target and draft models demonstrate up to 8.3% acceleration over the reflection coupling baseline in practical settings.
summary_zh: 推测采样通过生成低成本候选状态、在可严格保留目标分布的耦合机制下校正候选结果，减少高成本目标模型的评估次数，进而加速扩散模型生成。现有扩散采样器（尤其是基于反射最大耦合的采样器）存在拓扑约束：前瞻草稿构成链状图，即单一线性序列，这一特性从本质上限制了单次目标评估的接受率。本文将扩散模型的推测采样与相对熵编码（Relative Entropy Coding, REC）相关联，该视角证明前瞻过程无需为线性结构，进而提出核心创新点草稿树，可丰富每一轮考虑的候选集数量，降低目标函数的评估次数。本文进一步采用相对熵编码算法中的贪心拒绝采样作为草稿-目标耦合机制，在保证生成样本严格符合目标分布的前提下提升接受率。在多类目标模型与草稿模型上开展的实验表明，在实际部署场景下，该方法相比反射耦合基线最高可实现8.3%的速度提升。

title: The Missing "I Don't Know": Why Three Reasoning-Reliability Findings Converge on Calibrated Abstention
title_zh: 缺失的“我不知道”：三项推理可靠性研究结论为何共同指向校准型弃权机制
authors: Srijith Ravikumar
abstract: Three recent results describe what look like unrelated LLM reliability problems. Yin et al. (2026) show reasoning RL collapses tool-reliability representations. Suleymanov et al. (2026) show that under safety-constrained generation, large models rewrite flagged spans while small models truncate. Bastounis et al. (2024) prove any consistent-reasoning system without an implicit "I don't know" function must hallucinate infinitely often on broad problem classes. We argue these findings converge on a single intervention: calibrated abstention is what each independently identifies as the missing capability, even though the unavailability they document, a capability gap, a policy gap, and a recursion-theoretic gap, has a different source in each case. Honesty post-training has narrowed the gap in deployed models, but principled closure of the class Bastounis identifies requires a calibrated abstention function whose training signal at the leaderboard level is absent: dominant benchmarks assign zero reward to decline, so the leaderboard gradient that would select for the function does not exist. We propose four changes to evaluation: triple-scoring, abstention-rate reporting, capability-stratified evaluation, and mandatory calibration metrics. Benchmark reform is necessary, not sufficient, for closing the gap the theorem identifies.
summary_zh: 近期三项研究分别提出了看似互不相关的大语言模型可靠性问题：Yin et al. (2026) 发现推理强化学习会破坏工具可靠性表征；Suleymanov et al. (2026) 发现在安全约束生成场景下，大模型会重写被标记的风险片段，而小模型会直接截断内容；Bastounis et al. (2024) 从理论上证明，对于广泛的问题类别，任何不具备隐式“我不知道”功能的一致性推理系统都会无限次生成幻觉。本文指出上述三项研究结论共同指向同一解决方案：校准型弃权机制正是三项研究各自独立发现的缺失能力，三类问题的根源分别是能力缺口、政策缺口、递归理论缺口，存在明显差异。现有部署模型通过诚实后训练缩小了部分缺口，但要从原理上填补Bastounis提出的理论层面缺口，需要校准型弃权机制，而当前主流基准数据集的训练信号中完全没有该机制的相关内容：主流基准对拒绝回答的行为给出零奖励，因此不存在可筛选出该能力的基准梯度。本文提出四项评估改进方案：三重打分机制、弃权率报告、能力分层评估、强制校准指标。基准体系改革是填补该理论缺口的必要条件，而非充分条件。

title: Reflect, Revise, Reuse: Training-Free Skill Evolution for GUI Agents
title_zh: 反思、修正、复用：面向GUI智能体的无训练技能演化框架
authors: Bofan Chen, Boxuan Zhang, Fei Tang, Zhengxi Lu, Yong Du, Tongbo Chen, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen
abstract: GUI agents execute long-horizon tasks on dynamic graphical user interfaces, where pop-ups, delayed loads, and relocated widgets routinely invalidate plans fixed before execution. Recent agent-skill frameworks encapsulate reusable procedural knowledge to mitigate this, yet existing skill designs are largely developed without targeting GUI execution dynamics and treat skills as static artifacts produced before deployment rather than living procedural knowledge that improves through it. We argue that what GUI agents need is not better static skills, but skills that can be revised from execution feedback at deployment time, without additional training. We propose \textbf{EvoSkill-GUI}, a training-free framework in which each skill is a structured multi-file package containing retrieval metadata, executable plans, backup localization, failure-recovery rules, accessibility utilities, and failure cases. EvoSkill-GUI operates through a \textbf{\emph{reflect-revise-reuse}} loop: the executor performs instant in-rollout revisions, an isolated critic diagnoses failed trajectories under strict information isolation, and the executor edits specific skill files through a restricted tool interface. Across MobileWorld, AndroidWorld, and OSWorld, three mainstream GUI benchmarks spanning mobile and desktop platforms, EvoSkill-GUI consistently improves multiple base models without any training, with maximum gains of $+16.2\%$, $+6.0\%$, and $+10.5\%$ respectively, and evolved skill libraries continue to benefit related tasks rather than being rebuilt from scratch. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/EvoSkill-GUI.
summary_zh: 图形用户界面（Graphical User Interface, GUI）智能体需要在动态GUI上执行长周期任务，运行过程中弹出窗口、加载延迟、控件位置变动等问题经常会导致部署前预设的计划失效。近期提出的智能体技能框架将可复用的过程性知识封装起来以缓解该问题，但现有技能设计大多未针对GUI执行动态特性优化，将技能视为部署前生成的静态产物，而非可在部署过程中持续迭代优化的活的过程性知识。本文指出GUI智能体需要的不是更优的静态技能，而是可在部署阶段基于执行反馈完成修正、无需额外训练的技能，进而提出EvoSkill-GUI这一无训练框架：框架中的每个技能都是结构化多文件包，包含检索元数据、可执行计划、备用定位方案、故障恢复规则、无障碍工具集与失败案例。EvoSkill-GUI通过“反思-修正-复用”循环运行：执行器可在任务执行过程中即时完成技能修订，独立的评估模块在严格信息隔离条件下诊断失败轨迹，执行器通过受限工具接口编辑特定技能文件。在覆盖移动端与桌面端的三大主流GUI基准数据集MobileWorld、AndroidWorld、OSWorld上的实验结果表明，EvoSkill-GUI无需任何训练即可持续提升多个基础模型的性能，最高性能提升幅度分别为16.2%、6.0%、10.5%，且演化得到的技能库可直接复用于相关任务，无需从零开始重建。相关代码已开源至https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/EvoSkill-GUI。

title: Rethinking Domain Specialization for Open-Ended Scientific Reasoning in Astronomy Language Models
title_zh: 面向天文语言模型开放式科学推理的领域专业化反思
authors: Vanessa Lama, Sanjay Das, Emily Herron, Yuan-Sen Ting, Tijmen de Haan, Junqi Yin, Tirthankar Ghosal, Feiyi Wang
abstract: Domain-specialized language models are widely used for scientific question answering, but stronger general-purpose systems raise a sharper question: when does domain-specific fine-tuning remain valuable for open-ended scientific reasoning? We study this in astronomy with a curated QA benchmark from publicly available 2017--2026 Olympiad-style materials. The free-response subset contains 300 questions, including 204 text-only and 96 image-linked examples. We compare open-weight and API-served general-purpose, multimodal, and astronomy-specialized models using judge-based correctness and complementary reference metrics. Strong general-purpose models establish the highest correctness baseline in this testbed, while analyses of metric agreement, judge sensitivity, benchmark composition, and modality reveal variation not captured by a single leaderboard. These results motivate treating domain specialization as a task- and deployment-dependent property and highlight the role of domain-specific evaluation in determining which models, capabilities, and evaluation criteria are appropriate for scientific workflows.
summary_zh: 领域专用语言模型已被广泛应用于科学问答场景，但性能更强的通用大模型引发了一个值得深入探讨的问题：针对开放式科学推理任务，领域专用微调在什么场景下仍然具备不可替代的价值？本文基于2017-2026年公开的奥赛风格天文试题材料，构建了经过人工筛选的问答基准数据集开展相关研究。其中自由作答子集包含300道题目，涵盖204道纯文本题和96道关联图像的题目。本文采用基于评判器的准确率指标与互补参考指标，对开源权重、API调用类的通用模型、多模态模型以及天文专用模型开展了对比实验。结果表明，当前强通用模型在该测试集上取得了最高的准确率基线，但对指标一致性、评判器敏感度、基准构成与模态特性的分析显示，单一排行榜无法完整反映不同模型的性能差异。该研究结果表明，领域专业化应当被视为依赖具体任务与部署场景的属性，同时凸显了领域专属评估在筛选适配科学工作流的模型、能力维度与评估标准中的核心作用。

title: Scaling Articulated Rationales for MLLM-based Recommendation
title_zh: 面向多模态大语言模型推荐的可解释理由规模化方法
authors: Haoke Xiao, Yueyang Liu, Yuhui Zhang, Xiang Chen, Yufei Liu, Jia Xu, Yalong Guan, Xiaolan Zhu, Xiaoyu Zhang, Shijun Wang, Shuang Yang, Zijie Meng, Zejian Zhang, Ruochen Yang, Xiangyu Wu, Tingting Gao, Han Li, Lantao Hu, Cheng Luo, Kun Gai
abstract: Modern recommendation systems largely infer user preferences from implicit behaviors such as clicks, watch time, and negative feedback, but these signals reveal what users do rather than why they like or dislike content. This work studies articulated user rationales (AURs), i.e., users' natural-language explanations of their preferences, as a new class of polarity-aware and reason-level textual signals for recommendation. Despite their potential value, AURs are difficult to use in industrial systems because they are naturally sparse, often low-quality, and only cover a small fraction of items. We present SARA (Scaling Articulated Rationales), an industrial framework that turns sparse AURs into scalable recommendation signals. SARA first builds a data engine that elicits and curates AURs from 240M Kuaishou Live users, producing SARA-HQ, a quality-controlled and author-centric rationale dataset. It then aligns a general-purpose MLLM into SARA-7B through large-scale SFT and Quality-Refining DPO, extending rationale generation from 86,564 AUR-covered authors to the full 10M-author space. Finally, SARA-Ranker integrates the generated positive and negative rationales into production ranking via rationale-aware interaction modeling and rejection-memory modeling. Extensive offline evaluation, human calibration, and online A/B tests show that SARA-7B generates more specific, polarity-consistent, and grounded rationales than strong MLLM baselines, while SARA-Ranker improves engagement and reduces negative feedback in production. Deployed with daily refresh for over 30 days, SARA establishes articulated rationales as a practical, first-class textual signal for industrial recommendation systems.
summary_zh: 现代推荐系统大多基于点击、观看时长、负反馈等隐式行为推断用户偏好，但这类信号只能反映用户的行为，无法解释用户喜爱或厌恶内容的底层原因。本文研究了显式用户理由（Articulated User Rationales, AURs），即用户用自然语言表述的偏好解释，这类全新的文本信号同时具备极性感知和理由层级的特性，可用于推荐任务。尽管AURs具备潜在应用价值，但天然稀疏、质量参差不齐、仅覆盖少量物品的特性导致其难以在工业系统中落地。本文提出SARA（Scaling Articulated Rationales，可扩展显式理由框架）这一工业级框架，可将稀疏的AURs转化为可规模化应用的推荐信号。SARA首先搭建数据引擎，从2.4亿快手直播用户中征集并筛选AURs，生成以创作者为中心、经过质量管控的理由数据集SARA-HQ；随后通过大规模监督微调（SFT）与质量优化直接偏好优化（Quality-Refining DPO），将通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）对齐为SARA-7B，将理由生成能力从覆盖86564名AUR创作者扩展到全部1000万创作者；最后SARA-Ranker通过理由感知交互建模与拒识记忆建模，将生成的正负理由整合到线上排序流程中。大量离线评估、人工校准与在线A/B测试结果表明，SARA-7B生成的理由比现有强MLLM基线更具体、极性一致性更高、事实支撑更充分，同时SARA-Ranker可有效提升线上用户互动率、降低负反馈。经过超过30天的每日刷新部署，SARA验证了显式理由可作为工业推荐系统中实用的一级文本信号。

title: Lecture notes on Physics Informed Neural Networks, Neural Operators, and their applications
title_zh: 物理信息神经网络、神经算子及其应用讲义
authors: Alessandro Bombini
abstract: The goal of the course was to introduce the concept of Physics Informed Deep Neural Networks (PINN) and Neural Operators (NOs), discuss their implementation from scratch in PyTorch and using advanced ad-hoc developed open-source libraries such as NVIDia PhysicsNeMo to address real-world problems in various fields (engineering, physics, petroleum reservoir). We discuss recent topics such as Mixture-of-Models, Fourier Neural Operators, Physics-Informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (PIKANs) and Fourier Neural Operators.
summary_zh: 本课程旨在介绍物理信息深度神经网络（Physics Informed Deep Neural Networks, PINN）与神经算子（Neural Operators, NOs）的核心概念，讲解如何基于PyTorch从零实现相关算法，以及如何使用NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo等专门开发的先进开源库解决工程、物理、油气藏等多个领域的实际问题。课程覆盖了模型混合（Mixture-of-Models）、傅里叶神经算子（Fourier Neural Operators）、物理信息Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（Physics-Informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, PIKANs）等前沿研究方向。

title: What You Can't See Is Still What You Learn: A Preregistered Sixty-Society Confirmation That Evidence Masking Drives Compositional Generalization
title_zh: 你无法观测的信息仍会决定你的学习效果：针对60个系统的预注册验证证实证据掩码可提升组合泛化能力
authors: Narcis Marincat
abstract: Restricting what a module can read may improve what a system learns to compute. We test this in a preregistered confirmation with sixty four-cell systems sharing a frozen language-model backbone and communicating through learned continuous packets. Five conditions vary evidence masking, ownership markers, and replacement of foreign evidence with neutral filler, across six initialization clusters, each with two data orders, on one fresh task world. With markers available in both regimes, masking improved accuracy on held-out two- and three-operation compositions by median paired differences of 0.846 and 0.859; all twelve pairs cleared the required margins, and the full preregistered behavioral criterion passed. The unmarked replication also passed. No globally visible system passed the marker-following check, so the effect of usable role information remains unresolved. The filler condition yielded seven full generalizers, but its decomposition criteria were inconclusive. Packet interventions in all eighteen audited masked systems followed the predicted intermediate-value changes on eligible cases; these finite, success-conditioned audits do not establish mediation. The results confirm a large advantage of the tested masking regime, while leaving its finer attribution and generality open. Protocols, results, and checkpoints are public.
summary_zh: 限制模块的可读取信息范围，可能提升系统学习计算任务的性能。本文通过预注册验证实验开展相关测试，实验包含60个共享冻结语言模型主干、通过可学习连续数据包通信的四元系统。实验设置5种变量条件，调整证据掩码、所有权标记、外来证据替换为中性填充项的规则，覆盖6个初始化集群，每个集群对应两种数据顺序，运行在全新的任务环境中。在两种设置均提供标记的情况下，掩码策略在未见过的双操作、三操作组合任务上的准确率中位数配对差值分别达到0.846和0.859，全部12组配对均满足预设的性能阈值，通过了完整的预注册行为判定标准。无标记的重复实验同样通过了验证。所有全局可见系统均未通过标记遵循性检查，因此可用角色信息的作用机制仍有待进一步研究。填充项条件生成了7个完全泛化的系统，但其分解判定结果尚不明确。在18个经过审计的掩码系统中开展的数据包干预实验显示，符合条件的样本均出现了预测的中间值变化，但这类基于成功样本的有限审计无法确认因果中介效应。研究结果证实，测试所用的掩码策略具备显著性能优势，但其更精细的归因与泛化性仍有待探索。所有实验协议、结果与模型检查点均已公开。

title: Physics-Constrained Digital Twins for Sensor Integrity in Urban Pedestrian Flow: Detecting Stealthy False Data Injection with Conformal Guarantees
title_zh: 单颜色预处理优化DSATUR算法
authors: Oscar Mogollon Gutierrez, Fatemeh Ghasemi, Mohammadhossein Homaei, Andres Caro, Mar Avila
abstract: City pedestrian counting systems now feed economic indicators, planning decisions and safety operations, yet the twins built on top of them treat the incoming stream as ground truth. We study what happens when it is not. We formalise stealthy false data injection for city-scale pedestrian sensing, where the map from latent flow to observation is far more rank deficient than in the power and water networks for which stealth has been characterised. Our twin estimates directed flows on the pedestrian street graph, assimilates counts through a learned graph-localised gain, and is trained against a flow conservation residual that couples metered and unmetered segments. Detection combines the innovation with that residual, and the alarm threshold is set by adaptive conformal calibration rather than by hand. To measure what the physics buys, we define the attack margin, the relative reduction in worst-case corruption of the estimated flow field, achieved against a white-box adversary that optimises directly through the twin. On six years of Melbourne data the margin reaches 0.54 against a single compromised device and falls to 0.19 when a third of the fleet is compromised, on a network where only 1.18 per cent of walkable segments are metered. Replacing the street graph by a distance graph collapses it to 0.09, which shows that the gain comes from the conservation law rather than from locality.
summary_zh: 图着色问题（Graph Coloring Problem, GCP）属于NP难问题，DSATUR是求解该问题速度最快的启发式算法之一，但该算法生成的着色方案使用的颜色数通常多于当前最先进的着色算法。本文提出SSLD（Semidefinite Spectral Learning with DSATUR，结合半定谱学习的DSATUR算法），该算法通过预处理生成第一个优质色类，再调用DSATUR完成图剩余部分的着色，实现对DSATUR的性能优化。该色类通过半定规划（Semidefinite Programming, SDP）求解得到，所用SDP框架与计算Lovász theta数的SDP方法类似。据本文作者所知，SSLD是首个通过固定色类预处理优化DSATUR的方法。本文在DIMACS基准集、随机图（Erdős–Rényi、Watts-Strogatz、Barabási–Albert）、频率分配与作业车间调度数据集上，对比了SSLD、原始DSATUR与朴素单色类预处理算法的性能。在超过1600个基准实例上，SSLD在几乎所有场景下的表现都与DSATUR持平甚至更优，且性能优于朴素基线算法GISD，验证了SDP引导的首个色类选择的价值。该性能提升的代价是运行速度约为原始DSATUR的1/195，但其证明了SDP引导的首个色类预处理是未来算法优化的重要方向。

title: One Color Preprocessing Improves DSATUR
title_zh: 实现AI辅助主张的独立可质疑性：发布权威机制与可证伪发布记录协议
authors: Adam Nouira, Lucas Isenmann
abstract: The Graph Coloring Problem (GCP) is NP-hard and DSATUR stands as one of the fastest heuristics for it despite producing colorings that typically use more colors than state-of-the-art coloring algorithms. We propose SSLD (Semidefinite Spectral Learning with DSATUR), which improves DSATUR by preprocessing a first good color class before letting DSATUR complete coloring the rest of the given graph. We obtain this color class from a Semidefinite Programming (SDP), similar to an SDP used to compute the Lov\'asz theta number. To the best of our knowledge, SSLD is the first approach to improve DSATUR by preprocessing through fixed color classes. We evaluate SSLD against DSATUR and against a naive 1-color-class preprocessing algorithm on DIMACS instances, random graphs (Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi, Watts-Strogatz, Barab\'asi--Albert), Frequency Assignment and Job Shop Scheduling instances. SSLD matches or beats DSATUR in almost every case across over 1600 benchmark instances, and out performs the naive GISD baseline, allows us to confirm the value brought by the SDP-guided choice of the first color class. This quality comes at a runtime cost of roughly 195 times slower that DSATUR, but demonstrating that SDP-guided preprocessing of a first color class is a direction for future improvements.
summary_zh: 当AI辅助主张对应的证据、分析过程、人工授权、展示形式与修正历史指向不同状态时，这类主张往往会呈现出不合理的权威性。溯源、认证与透明度机制可披露相关历史信息，但无法定义本文所研究的发布转换规则。本文提出发布权威机制，这是一种精确状态、不可转让、单次使用的发布能力，并在PAC-2026（发布问责演算）中完成实例化，PAC-2026是符合机器可读要求的AIJIM协议候选方案。本文评估了其第四版有界语义冻结规范（SF-4），这是为可替换绑定设计的固定配置规范。该规范包含6项约束，分别覆盖证据、运行与产物、测量披露、授权、界面一致性与生命周期连续性，每项约束都会生成绑定目标的见证信息、局部反例或局部不可验证性证明，不同约束的作用无法相互替代。只有完整通过所有校验的全新记录，才能生成单次原子发布转换所需的许可。本文使用身份向量、对抗样本、有限模型与历史实现开展验证，10个测试模型探索了110764个安全可达状态，76个不安全配置均生成了预期的违规结果或观测反例。通过一致性校验的用户界面无法触发发布流程，除非提交的完整记录可支持该界面的合法性。SF-4将证据边界与验证时间解耦，可拒绝合法但因果无效的授权。历史前置路径实验复现了17个冻结授权后继结果，后续针对已知案例类的实例盲测试全部匹配183项预期结果，同主机包执行复现了240项存档观测结果。实验结果验证了该机制的内部一致性、有界安全性、故障敏感性与有限可构建性，但无法保证事实真实性、通用可优化性、盲互操作性、现场有效性或标准合规性。

title: EvolveTrade: Experience-Driven Policy Refinement for Self-Evolving LLM Trading Agents
title_zh: EvolveTrade：面向自进化大语言模型交易智能体的经验驱动策略优化框架
authors: Sehee Kim, Yumin Choi, Minki Kang, Sung Ju Hwang
abstract: Large language model (LLM) trading agents can combine market data, news, and executable analysis, but their behavior is often controlled by static hand-written tool-use policies that are fixed before deployment. This limits their ability to adapt how they gather evidence, invoke tools, verify signals, and manage risk under changing market regimes. We introduce EvolveTrade, a self-evolving framework that treats the system prompt of a tool-using trading agent as a text-parameterized policy. After each update interval, a Policy Agent revises this policy using accumulated decision traces and realized portfolio feedback, while keeping the backbone LLM fixed. The updated policy is then used for the next batch of trading decisions, enabling the agent to refine its information-acquisition and portfolio-construction procedure over time. Experiments across multiple market regimes and two LLM backbones show that EvolveTrade often improves Sharpe Ratio and Cumulative Return over fixed-policy LLM baselines, achieving the improved SR and CR in most evaluated settings. Behavioral analyses further show that self-evolved policies increase code-mediated analysis and activate regime-relevant computations; case-level policy-to-return attributions trace how policy-induced allocation changes contribute to realized return differences. These results suggest that adapting the reusable procedure governing tool use is a key direction for building more robust LLM trading agents.
summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）交易智能体可整合市场数据、新闻与可执行分析能力，但现有系统的行为通常由部署前人工编写的静态工具调用策略控制，限制了其在变化的市场环境中调整证据收集、工具调用、信号验证与风险管理流程的自适应能力。本文提出EvolveTrade这一自进化框架，将工具调用类交易智能体的系统提示词视为文本参数化的策略。在每个更新周期结束后，策略智能体基于累积的决策轨迹与实际投资组合反馈对该策略进行迭代优化，同时保持主干LLM参数固定。更新后的策略将用于下一批次的交易决策，使智能体能够逐步优化信息获取与投资组合构建流程。在多种市场环境与两类LLM主干上开展的实验表明，与采用固定策略的LLM基线相比，EvolveTrade在多数评估场景下均提升了夏普比率与累计收益率。行为分析进一步表明，自进化策略提升了代码辅助分析的占比，可激活与当前市场环境匹配的计算逻辑；案例级别的策略-收益归因分析明确了策略引发的仓位调整如何驱动最终收益差异。研究结果表明，优化控制工具调用流程的可复用规则，是构建更鲁棒的LLM交易智能体的核心方向。

title: Making AI-Assisted Claims Independently Challengeable: Publication Authority and a Protocol for Falsifiable Publication Records
authors: Torsten Olivi Tiltack, Yifei Dong, Kun Yu, Xu Wang, Wei Liu, Jianlong Zhou, Ren Ping Liu, Fang Chen
abstract: AI-assisted claims can appear authoritative when evidence, analysis, human authorization, presentation, and correction history refer to different states. Provenance, attestation, and transparency expose history but alone do not specify the publication transition examined here. We develop Publication Authority as an exact-state, non-transferable, single-use publication capability and instantiate it in PAC-2026 (Publication-Accountability Calculus), a machine-readable AIJIM Protocol candidate. We evaluate its fourth bounded semantic freeze (SF-4), a fixed-profile specification designed for replaceable bindings. Six obligations govern evidence, runs and artifacts, measurement disclosure, authorization, surface correspondence, and lifecycle continuity. Each yields a target-bound witness, localized counterexample, or localized unverifiability; none can compensate for another. Only a fresh, complete all-pass record derives the permit consumed by one atomic publication transition. We use identity vectors, adversarial cases, finite models, and historical implementations. Ten models explored 110,764 safe reachable states; 76 unsafe configurations produced the expected violation or observer countermodel. A reader surface passing its correspondence check cannot authorize publication unless the accepted record admits that surface. SF-4 separates evidence horizon from verification time and rejects an authentic but causally invalid authorization. A historical predecessor path reproduced 17 frozen authorization-successor outcomes. A later in-house, instance-blind test of known case classes matched all 183 scored expectations; same-host package execution reproduced its 240 archived observations. Results support internal coherence, bounded safety, fault sensitivity, and limited constructibility, but not factual truth, general refinement, blind interoperability, field efficacy, or standards status.

title: Decentralized Optimal Equilibrium Learning Over Dynamic Networks
title_zh: 动态网络下的去中心化最优均衡学习
authors: Seref Taha Kiremitci, Muhammed O. Sayin
abstract: This paper studies decentralized learning of socially optimal equilibria in finite normal-form games over dynamic communication networks. Each agent observes only its own realized payoffs, does not know the game a priori, and can communicate only with time-varying neighbors using low-bandwidth messages. We propose networked decentralized optimal equilibrium learning dynamics in which agents generate randomized semantic content/discontent signals from local payoff comparisons and exchange time-stamped time-stacked tables rather than raw actions, payoff information or local estimates/parameters. The method combines table fusion with temporal majority reconstruction to mitigate dynamic communication while preserving fully decentralized operation. We establish finite-time logarithmic regret guarantees, with an in-phase exploration perturbation, for optimal equilibrium selection under utilitarian and proportional-fair social welfare objectives. Simulation results further show that the proposed approach can effectively select socially desirable equilibria over dynamic communication networks.
summary_zh: 本文研究了动态通信网络下有限标准型博弈的社会最优均衡去中心化学习问题。场景中每个智能体仅能观测自身的实际收益，预先不掌握博弈规则，仅能通过低带宽消息与时变邻居通信。本文提出网络化去中心化最优均衡学习动力学机制，智能体基于局部收益对比生成随机的语义满意/不满意信号，交换带时间戳的时序堆叠表，而非原始动作、收益信息或局部估计参数。该方法结合表融合与时序多数重构技术，在保留完全去中心化运行特性的前提下，适配动态通信场景。本文在带相位探索扰动的设置下，针对功利主义与比例公平社会福利目标，证明了最优均衡选择的有限时间对数遗憾保证。仿真结果进一步表明，所提方法可在动态通信网络中有效选择符合社会期望的均衡。

title: Structure is not mechanism: high-gain gated-FFN rows across text and genomic foundation models
title_zh: 结构不等于机制：文本与基因组基础模型中的高增益门控前馈网络行特征
authors: Alexandros Tzanakakis, Aris Karatzikos, Ilias Georgakopoulos-Soares
abstract: A small number of unusually high-gain parameters can exert disproportionate effects in transformer language models, but whether analogous structures recur in genomic foundation models and whether structural geometry determines functional importance remains unknown. We analyzed high-gain rows in gated feed-forward networks across text and genomic foundation models, including a frozen 22-model causal census. Computing an associated bilinear weight operator exactly, without a diagonal approximation, we tested whether structural extremeness is a transferable mechanism. Activation-derived candidates were functionally enriched relative to random and top-norm same-layer controls, yet neither spectral concentration nor operator magnitude predicted causal effect size, and these associations vanished within the endpoint-homogeneous text-decoder subset. A within-layer sweep of 36 rows in one genomic and one text decoder resolved this into two regimes: below the detector's acceptance threshold the ratio carried no positive information about causal damage, whereas above it the ratio ordered rows strongly but did not grade severity as a dose-response. The same sweep revealed a second individually catastrophic row invisible to a one-candidate-per-model census, and non-additive damage among co-located critical rows. Case studies showed divergent causal organizations: a robust super-additive pair interaction in DNABERT-2, and in GENERator a sharply position-localized dependence in which preserving or restoring the row's beginning-of-sequence contribution rescued essentially all native-loss damage. High-gain gated-FFN rows are therefore a recurrent architectural phenotype whose structural prominence acts as an enrichment signal, not a calibrated measure of functional criticality or a specification of causal organization. Enrichment is general, but the mechanism is model-specific.
summary_zh: Transformer语言模型中少量异常高增益参数可产生不成比例的显著影响，但这类类似结构是否在基因组基础模型中普遍存在、结构几何特性是否决定功能重要性仍不明确。本文分析了文本与基因组基础模型门控前馈网络（gated feed-forward network, gated-FFN）中的高增益行特征，覆盖包含22个冻结因果模型的全量普查数据集。在不使用对角近似的前提下精确计算关联双线性权重算子，验证结构极端性是否为可迁移的通用机制。与随机对照和同层最高范数对照相比，基于激活筛选的候选行在功能层面显著富集，但谱集中度与算子幅值均无法预测因果效应大小，且这类关联在结构均一的文本解码器子集中完全消失。通过在一个基因组解码器与一个文本解码器中对36个行开展层内遍历测试，可将结果划分为两种模式：在检测器接受阈值以下，高增益行的相关比值无法提供关于因果损伤程度的有效信息；在阈值以上，该比值可对行的重要性进行强排序，但无法作为剂量响应关系衡量损伤严重程度。该遍历测试还发现了另一个未被单模型单候选普查方法识别的独立灾难性行，以及共位关键行之间的非加性损伤效应。案例研究揭示了不同模型的差异化因果组织模式：DNABERT-2中存在鲁棒的超加性成对交互效应，GENERator中存在严格的位置局部依赖，仅保留或恢复该行的序列起始贡献即可挽回几乎全部原生损失损伤。综上，高增益门控FFN行是普遍存在的架构表型，其结构显著性仅可作为功能富集信号，无法作为功能重要性的校准度量，也不能定义因果组织规则。这类富集特性具备通用性，但对应的作用机制是模型专属的。

title: Evolutionary Ensemble Search: Council-Guided Program Evolution with Persistent Memory
title_zh: 进化集成搜索（Evolutionary Ensemble Search, EES）：基于持久内存的委员会引导程序进化
authors: Juan P. Madrigal-Cianci, Eshan Chordia
abstract: Evolutionary Ensemble Search (EES) constructs machine-learning procedures through expert-guided program evolution. A role-specialized council turns task evidence and experimental results into structured search directions. An orchestrator allocates these directions to execution specialists and an evolutionary engine. The engine selects measured parents, diagnoses their errors, and produces descendants through code mutation, structured pipeline edits, and crossover. Each child must execute and acquire its own validation evidence. Population archives retain useful alternatives, while compatible predictions compete in a validation-gated ensemble stage. Search adapts through parent-relative operator credit, session memory, and problem-indexed lessons retrieved across runs. We specify these mechanisms, distinguish their execution profiles, and define the contracts required to compare candidates as their computations change. A public MLE-bench Lite development ledger records medal-threshold artifacts on 19 of 22 tasks (86.36\%), with best outcomes of 11 gold, five silver, and three bronze. The procedures span text, images, tables, audio, scientific geometry, and deterministic transformations. The campaign includes grade feedback between runs, external-source routes, and mixed confirmation procedures; its aggregate is an achieved development result, not a blind autonomous-agent success rate. The report contributes a concrete architecture for cumulative executable search and a versioned account of its cross-modal development outcomes.
summary_zh: 进化集成搜索（EES）通过专家引导的程序进化构建机器学习流程。角色专业化的委员会将任务证据和实验结果转化为结构化搜索方向，编排器将这些方向分配给执行专员和进化引擎。引擎筛选经过度量的父代，诊断其错误，并通过代码变异、结构化流水线编辑和交叉生成子代。每个子代必须执行并获取自身的验证证据。种群归档保留可用的替代方案，而兼容的预测会在验证门控的集成阶段展开竞争。搜索过程通过父代相关的算子信用分配、会话内存以及跨运行检索的带问题索引的经验实现自适应。本文明确了上述机制，区分了它们的执行特征，并定义了在计算发生变化时对比候选方案所需的契约。公开的MLE-bench Lite开发记录显示，该方法在22项任务中的19项（占比86.36%）上达到了奖牌级阈值成果，其中金牌11项、银牌5项、铜牌3项。生成的流程覆盖文本、图像、表格、音频、科学几何和确定性变换场景。该研究包含运行间的等级反馈、外部源路径和混合确认流程，其整体成果是已实现的开发结果，而非盲自主智能体的成功率。本研究提出了面向累积可执行搜索的具体架构，并提供了其跨模态开发结果的版本化记录。

title: Where Grokking Happens: Distributed Utility and Fourier Recoding Without a Module Switch
title_zh: Grokking（顿悟）发生的位置：无模块切换下的分布式效用与傅里叶重编码
authors: Dekun Yang
abstract: Where in a Transformer is the change from memorization to generalization functionally expressed? We introduce Transition Games--behavior-aligned exact activation games with paired non-generalizing controls--and find distributed utility gain with a prospective block-0 attention bias; selected degree-two modes account for 67--92% of its addition contrast across replacement games, and a disjoint exact path study confirms that block-1 MLP mediates more of their effect than all other tested downstream paths in 12/12 pairs. The sharper "MLP memorizes, attention generalizes" prediction instead reverses (-.331 bits/example at the memory anchor; 0/12 in the predicted direction), while routing onset, global rank collapse, and a prime-invariant architecture ridge also fail, identifying grokking here as spectral recoding of an existing distributed circuit rather than a module switch.
summary_zh: Transformer中从记忆到泛化的转变在功能层面是在哪个位置表达的？本文提出过渡博弈（Transition Games）——与行为对齐的精确激活博弈，搭配成对的非泛化对照组——发现分布式效用增益与潜在的第0块注意力偏置相关；在替换博弈中，选定的二阶模态占其加法对比度的67%~92%，独立的精确路径研究证实，在12/12的配对样本中，第1块多层感知机（MLP）对上述效应的介导作用超过所有其他测试的下游路径总和。而更尖锐的“MLP负责记忆、注意力负责泛化”的预测反而完全相反（在记忆锚点处为-0.331比特/样本，12组样本中0组符合预测方向），同时路由起始、全局秩坍缩和素数不变架构脊线的相关假设也不成立，由此识别出此处的Grokking是现有分布式电路的频谱重编码，而非模块切换。

title: Independence-System Realisations in Single-Source Unsplittable Flow
title_zh: 单源不可分流中的独立系统实现
authors: Koyar Afrasyab
abstract: Additive-congestion constraints in single-source unsplittable flow can enforce stable-set structure. This note isolates and generalises that mechanism. We introduce a path-closed notion of realising an independence system by the zero-cost choices of primary terminals in a directed acyclic flow instance. The definition quantifies over every directed source-terminal path and therefore remains valid under prefix borrowing, suffix splicing, and hybrid routes.Our main result extends the triangle mechanism: every finite loopless independence system has a polynomial-size realisation, measured in the incidence size of its minimal forbidden sets. Hence every finite simple graph, and more generally every hypergraph independence system without singleton forbidden hyperedges, is representable by an acyclic single-source gadget. We then specialise the construction to odd cycles. For C_{2k+1}, a uniform rational family produces a fractional cheap-selection vector that violates the odd-cycle inequality. A potential shift converts a signed connector separator into nonnegative arc costs and gives the exact cost-preserving additive-congestion threshold tau = 1 - bq. Within the symmetric family, the supremum threshold is (k+2)/(2(k+1)), which tends to 1/2. For C5, an exact certificate independently derives all source-terminal paths and enumerates all 3^10 = 59049 unsplittable routings using rational arithmetic.
summary_zh: 单源不可分流中的加性拥塞约束可以实现稳定集结构。本文分离并推广了该机制，提出了一种路径闭合的实现概念：在有向无环流实例中，通过主终端的零成本选择实现独立系统。该定义对所有有向源-终端路径进行量化，因此在前缀借用、后缀拼接和混合路由场景下均保持有效。本文的核心结果扩展了三角机制：每个有限无环独立系统都存在多项式规模的实现，其规模以最小禁止集的关联大小度量。因此，每个有限简单图，以及更一般的不含单元素禁止超边的超图独立系统，都可以通过无环单源小工具表示。随后本文将构造方法特化到奇环场景：对于C_{2k+1}，均匀有理族生成的分数低成本选择向量会违反奇环不等式，通过势变换可以将带符号的连接器分隔符转换为非负弧成本，得到精确的保成本加性拥塞阈值τ=1-bq。在对称族中，上确界阈值为(k+2)/(2(k+1))，该值趋近于1/2。对于C5，精确证书可独立推导所有源-终端路径，并使用有理运算枚举全部3^10=59049种不可分流路由。

title: BLADE: ReliaBle Dynamic Hardware-Aware SNN-ANN Boundary SeLection for Event-BAseD Object DEtection
title_zh: BLADE：面向基于事件的目标检测的可靠动态硬件感知SNN-ANN边界选择方法
authors: Mahdi Taheri, Alwin Paul
abstract: Hybrid Spiking Neural Network (SNN)-Artificial Neural Network (ANN) architectures combine the energy efficiency of SNNs with the superior detection accuracy of ANNs for event-based object detection. Existing hybrid SNN--ANN networks, however, employ static inference and select the SNN-ANN boundary primarily according to accuracy and energy consumption, without considering dynamic inference or reliability. This paper presents BLADE, the first reliability-aware boundary selection methodology for dynamic hybrid SNN-ANN networks with ANN early exit. The proposed framework jointly optimizes the SNN-ANN boundary and ANN early-exit configuration according to reliability, detection accuracy, execution time, and energy consumption, while incorporating reliability through hierarchical statistical fault injection during design-space exploration. Experimental evaluation on an event-based object detector achieves an mAP 0.5 of 0.691 while reducing the inference compute energy to 15.82~mJ when the ANN early exit fires. Reliability analysis identifies the most significant floating-point exponent bit as the dominant source of catastrophic failures, producing significant-or-worse accuracy degradation in 58.8% of its fault injections. Protecting this single bit with approximately 3% storage overhead eliminates catastrophic failures across the evaluated realistic technology fault rates. Furthermore, increasing the proportion of SNN computation improves fault tolerance, with the fully SNN configuration achieving a reliability retention of 0.965 under aggressive fault conditions. The results demonstrate that jointly optimizing reliability, accuracy, execution time, and energy consumption enables more dependable deployment of dynamic hybrid SNN--ANN systems for safety-critical edge AI applications.
summary_zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）-人工神经网络（ANN）混合架构结合了SNN的高能效和ANN的优异检测精度，适用于基于事件的目标检测任务。但现有混合SNN-ANN网络采用静态推理模式，主要根据精度和能耗选择SNN-ANN边界，未考虑动态推理和可靠性需求。本文提出BLADE，这是首个支持ANN提前退出的动态混合SNN-ANN网络的可靠性感知边界选择方法。该框架在设计空间探索过程中通过分层统计故障注入引入可靠性约束，联合优化SNN-ANN边界和ANN提前退出配置，同时兼顾可靠性、检测精度、执行时间和能耗。在基于事件的目标检测器上的实验评估显示，当触发ANN提前退出时，该方法的mAP 0.5达到0.691，推理计算能耗降至15.82mJ。可靠性分析发现，浮点数指数位的最高位是灾难性故障的主要来源，58.8%的故障注入会导致精度出现显著甚至更严重的下降。仅用约3%的存储开销对该位进行保护，即可在所有评估的真实技术故障率下完全消除灾难性故障。此外，提高SNN计算的占比可以提升容错性，全SNN配置在严苛故障条件下的可靠性保留率可达0.965。结果表明，联合优化可靠性、精度、执行时间和能耗，能够让动态混合SNN-ANN系统更可靠地部署在安全关键边缘AI场景中。

title: WARD: Runtime Workload-Adaptive Vision TRansformer Framework for Dependable Edge AI
title_zh: REQAP：面向边缘DNN加速的弹性权重打包与量化方法
authors: Mahdi Taheri, Pramit Kumar Bhaduri, Mohammad Masoumi, Ali Mahani
abstract: This paper presents WARD, a runtime-adaptive Vision Transformer framework that combines channel-wise subnetwork partitioning, reliability-aware continual learning, and dynamic operating-mode scheduling to jointly optimize performance, fault tolerance, and adaptation according to runtime conditions. Two physically isolated subnetworks execute under four operating modes (i.e. Full-Precision Mode, Low-Power Mode, High-Reliability Mode, and Adaptive Mode) that dynamically adjust computational cost and reliability while ensuring uninterrupted inference for real-time requirements. To validate the practical deployability of the proposed framework, WARD is implemented on a lightweight FPGA-based accelerator extended with runtime hardware support for mode scheduling and resource management. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed split architecture achieves a network-level failure rate of only 1.79% under high Bit Error Rates. The hardware implementation incurs less than 5% area overhead and supports runtime mode transitions within few clock cycles, demonstrating that adaptive reliability management can be integrated into programmable edge AI accelerators with negligible implementation overhead.
summary_zh: 深度神经网络（DNN）在边缘加速器上的高效部署需要在易故障硬件环境中实现极致的模型压缩，同时保持可靠性。本文提出一种面向基于脉动阵列的DNN加速器的可靠性感知量化权重打包方法。该灵敏度驱动的混合精度量化框架根据对精度的影响为各层分配位宽，同时强制权重和激活之间的精度对称。确定性的寄存器级打包策略将多个异构操作数对合并为固定宽度的寄存器字，实现寄存器内单指令多数据（SIMD-within-a-register, SWAR）风格的并行执行，同时减少内存占用和执行周期。为提升硬件故障弹性，选择性位级保护将关键层的最高有效位（MSB）复制到未使用的寄存器空间，以极小的开销实现三模冗余（TMR）风格的保护。本文开发了脉动阵列仿真框架，在真实执行条件下评估所提的打包和容错机制。在AlexNet、VGG-11和ResNet-18上的仿真结果显示，该方法最高可减少62%的内存占用和56%的乘累加（MAC）操作，与基线模型和全保护模型相比，故障注入下的精度弹性得到显著提升。

title: REQAP: Resilient Weight Packing and Quantization for Edge DNN Acceleration
authors: Mahdi Taheri, Samira Nazari, Mubassher Ansari, Ali Azarpeyvand, Mohsen Afsharchi, Maksim Jenihhin, Christian Herglotz
abstract: Efficient deployment of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) on edge accelerators requires aggressive model compression while maintaining reliability in fault-prone hardware environments. This paper presents a reliability-aware quantized weight packing methodology for systolic-array-based DNN accelerators. A sensitivity-driven mixed-precision quantization framework assigns layer-wise bit-widths according to accuracy impact while enforcing symmetric precision between weights and activations. A deterministic register-level packing strategy consolidates multiple heterogeneous operand pairs into fixed-width register words, enabling SIMD-within-a-register (SWAR) style parallel execution that reduces both memory footprint and execution cycles. To improve resilience against hardware faults, selective bit-level protection replicates the most significant bits (MSBs) of critical layers into unused register space, achieving TMR-style protection with minimal overhead. A systolic-array simulation framework is developed to evaluate the proposed packing and fault-tolerance mechanisms under realistic execution conditions. Simulations in AlexNet, VGG-11, and ResNet-18 demonstrate up to 62% memory reduction and up to 56% reduction in Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) operations, while significantly improving accuracy resilience under fault injection compared to baseline and fully protected models.

title: The Death of Schema Linking? Text-to-SQL in the Age of Well-Reasoned Language Models
title_zh: 模式链接已死？强推理大语言模型时代下的Text-to-SQL技术
authors: Karime Maamari, Fadhil Abubaker, Daniel Jaroslawicz, Amine Mhedhbi
abstract: Schema linking is a crucial step in Text-to-SQL pipelines. Its goal is to retrieve the relevant tables and columns of a target database for a user's query while disregarding irrelevant ones. However, imperfect schema linking can often exclude required columns needed for accurate query generation. In this work, we revisit schema linking when using the latest generation of large language models (LLMs). We find empirically that newer models are adept at utilizing relevant schema elements during generation even in the presence of large numbers of irrelevant ones. As such, our Text-to-SQL pipeline entirely forgoes schema linking in cases where the schema fits within the model's context window in order to minimize issues due to filtering required schema elements. Furthermore, instead of filtering contextual information, we highlight techniques such as augmentation, selection, and correction, and adopt them to improve the accuracy of our Text-to-SQL pipeline. Our approach ranks first on the BIRD benchmark achieving an accuracy of 71.83%.
summary_zh: 模式链接是Text-to-SQL流水线中的关键步骤，其目标是针对用户查询检索目标数据库中相关的表和列，同时忽略无关内容。但不完善的模式链接往往会排除生成准确查询所需的必要列。本研究重新审视了使用最新一代大语言模型（LLM）时的模式链接机制，通过实证发现，新一代模型即使在存在大量无关模式元素的情况下，也擅长在生成过程中利用相关模式元素。因此，当模式可以完全纳入模型的上下文窗口时，本文提出的Text-to-SQL流水线完全跳过模式链接步骤，以避免过滤掉必要模式元素带来的问题。此外，本文没有对上下文信息进行过滤，而是引入了增强、选择和校正等技术来提升Text-to-SQL流水线的精度。所提方法在BIRD基准上排名第一，准确率达到71.83%。

title: Exponential Hardness of Off-Policy Evaluation under History-Dependent Logging
title_zh: 历史依赖日志下离线策略评估的指数级难度
authors: Pranaya Jajoo
abstract: Can a logged dataset visit every hidden state frequently and still be exponentially uninformative about a target policy's value? We show that it can when the logger depends on history. For every horizon $H \ge 3$, we construct two POMDPs with at most two latent states per stage, three actions, and a common logger with three memory states. Action coverage, belief coverage, and two behavior-marginal outcome-revealing conditions all have constants independent of $H$. Nevertheless, evaluating a known deterministic target policy to accuracy $1/8$ requires $\Theta((3/2)^H \log(1/\delta))$ logged episodes at confidence $1-\delta$, for $0 < \delta \le 1/4$, even when both candidate models are known. The mechanism is simple: a reset erases the unknown transition that determines the target value. We characterize the resulting statistical experiment exactly and obtain a matching optimal estimator. A directed two-lane gridworld realizes the construction, and trajectory simulations agree with its finite-sample prediction. The result establishes intractability for the history-dependent-logging, model-based case posed by Zhang and Jiang (2025, arXiv:2503.01134), under their behavior-marginal definition of revealing.
summary_zh: 包含大量状态访问记录的日志数据集，是否仍会完全无法为目标策略的价值估计提供有效信息？本文证明当日志生成器依赖历史时，这种情况确实存在。对于任意大于等于3的视界H，本文构造了两个部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），每个阶段最多包含2个潜在状态、3个动作，共享一个拥有3个内存状态的日志生成器。动作覆盖率、信念覆盖率以及两个行为边际结果揭示条件的取值均为与H无关的常数。但即便已知两个候选模型，要将已知确定性目标策略的评估精度提升至1/8，在置信度1-δ（0<δ≤1/4）下仍需要Θ((3/2)^H log(1/δ))条日志片段。其机制十分简单：重置操作会擦除决定目标价值的未知转移。本文精确刻画了由此产生的统计实验，并得到了匹配的最优估计器。定向双车道网格世界可以实现该构造，轨迹仿真结果与有限样本预测一致。该结果证明了Zhang和Jiang（2025）提出的历史依赖日志下基于模型的离线策略评估问题，在他们定义的行为边际揭示条件下是不可解的。

title: How Model Growth, Recursion, and Boundary Operators Influence Scaling Exponents
title_zh: 模型增长、递归与边界算子对缩放指数的影响机制
authors: Zixi Chen, Akshay Vegesna, Samip Dahal, Andrew Gordon Wilson
abstract: Scaling laws predict how loss decreases with increases in computation. We show, contrary to conventional wisdom, that architectural interventions can modify scaling exponents in pre-training, leading to exponential improvements in performance with increases in computation. As an anchoring point, we consider the architectural formulation of looped transformers. Although not typically used in this way, looping, also known as recursive depth, provides a mechanism for model growth, by increasing the number of loops during training. Model growth, with and without shared weights, provides the biggest changes to the scaling exponents. In particular, a 7.4B model growth architecture matches GPT-3 13B on CORE with roughly $20\times$ less compute, and has compute efficiency gains that increase with scale. Moreover, simply using a boundary operator in a vanilla transformer, which normalizes and injects an earlier block, also provides increasing compute-efficiency gains, although to a lesser extent. In the data-constrained, multi-epoch setting, standard looping has a useful regularizing effect, where we find it is compute-optimal to increase the number of loops with scale. These results can be understood through the lens of computational depth: for a given computational budget, we wish to increase the usable depth of the transformer, which can lead to efficiency gains that increase with scale.
summary_zh: 缩放定律可以预测损失随计算量增加的下降规律。本文发现与传统认知相反，架构干预可以改变预训练过程中的缩放指数，实现性能随计算量增长的指数级提升。作为基准，本文考虑循环Transformer的架构形式：循环也被称为递归深度，虽然通常不被这样使用，但它提供了一种模型增长机制，可以在训练过程中通过增加循环次数实现模型规模扩张。无论是否共享权重，模型增长都能带来缩放指数的最大幅度变化。具体而言，7.4B参数的模型增长架构在CORE任务上匹配GPT-3 13B的性能，所需计算量仅为后者的约1/20，且计算效率增益随规模扩大而提升。此外，在普通Transformer中使用边界算子（对早期块的输出进行归一化并注入后续层）也能带来不断提升的计算效率增益，只是幅度相对更小。在数据受限的多轮训练场景下，标准循环机制具备有效的正则化效果，本文发现随规模扩大增加循环次数是计算最优的。上述结果可以从计算深度的角度解释：在给定计算预算下，提升Transformer的可用深度即可实现随规模递增的效率增益。

title: Monitoring and Discovering Reward Hacking with Internal Representations during LLM Evaluations
title_zh: 大语言模型评估中基于内部表示的奖励黑客行为监测与发现
authors: Leon Bergen, Usha Bhalla, Andrew Lee, Barak Widawsky, Linas Nasvytis, Connor Watts, Siddharth Boppana, Sidharth Baskaran, Dron Hazra, Michael Byun, Atticus Geiger, Owen Lewis, Matthew Kowal, Vasudev Shyam, Thomas Fel, Thomas McGrath, Ekdeep Singh Lubana, Jack Merullo
abstract: As models scale, reward hacking becomes more frequent, more sophisticated, and more consequential. Does it leave a telltale signature in model representations? This work analyzes how reward hacking is represented internally in frontier open source LLMs, and how those representations can be used to understand and discover the range of hacking behaviors a model displays. In particular, we find that simple difference of means vectors coherently represent reward hacking in Kimi K3, GLM 5.2, and Qwen 3.8 Max across a variety of behaviors in common evaluations. Despite their simplicity, these vectors are both generalizable and interpretable, and we can use them to reliably detect reward hacking. We first evaluate reward hacking in commonly reported benchmarks like DeepSWE and SWE-bench, finding that models reward hack excessively in these environments; GLM 5.2 hacks in 57.2% of rollouts on DeepSWE and in 73% of rollouts on SWE-bench. Catching these requires monitors; LLM monitors are effective, but expensive detectors. We show that DoM vectors are similarly effective but virtually free, catching 3.1% more hacks in Kimi K3 and 7.9% fewer hacks in GLM 5.2 on DeepSWE at a monitor matched false positive rate. DoM vectors run on the chain-of-thought also predict reward hacks in the model's subsequent actions, meaning we can run them online and catch potential hacks before they occur. Finally, we analyze probe-hits that LLM monitors do not catch and discover other undesirable behaviors, as well as show transfer to finding hacks in non-SWE evaluations. Together, these results provide evidence that simple, white-box methods can be used to scalably study and monitor reward hacking behaviors in frontier open source models
summary_zh: 随着模型规模扩大，奖励黑客行为出现得更频繁、更隐蔽、影响也更严重。这类行为是否会在模型的内部表示中留下可识别的特征？本研究分析了前沿开源大语言模型中奖励黑客行为的内部表示机制，以及如何利用这些表示理解和发现模型展现的各类黑客行为。具体而言，本文发现简单的均值差（DoM）向量可以在Kimi K3、GLM 5.2和Qwen 3.8 Max等模型中，跨多种常见评估行为一致地表征奖励黑客行为。尽管结构简单，这类向量兼具泛化性和可解释性，可以用于可靠地检测奖励黑客行为。本文首先在DeepSWE和SWE-bench等常用基准上评估奖励黑客行为，发现模型在这些环境中存在大量奖励黑客行为：GLM 5.2在DeepSWE的57.2%的滚动输出中存在黑客行为，在SWE-bench的73%的滚动输出中存在黑客行为。捕获这类行为需要监测器：大语言模型监测器效果好但计算成本高，本文证明DoM向量的检测效果与之相当但几乎没有额外开销，在匹配监测器假阳性率的前提下，在DeepSWE上对Kimi K3的黑客检出率高3.1%，对GLM 5.2的黑客检出率低7.9%。在思维链上运行的DoM向量还可以预测模型后续动作中的奖励黑客行为，意味着可以在线运行该方法，在黑客行为发生前将其拦截。最后，本文分析了大语言模型监测器未捕获的探针命中样本，发现了其他不良行为，同时验证了该方法可以迁移到非SWE评估场景的黑客检测中。上述结果共同证明，简单的白盒方法可以用于规模化研究和监测前沿开源模型的奖励黑客行为。

title: Evidence-Grounded Agentic Formulation Development in an Autonomous Laboratory
title_zh: 自主实验室中基于证据的智能体配方开发
authors: Michael M. Craig, Riley J. Hickman, Yingshan Ma, R\'emi Pich\'e-Taillefer, Christine Allen, Pauric Bannigan
abstract: Self-emulsifying drug delivery systems (SEDDS) can improve the oral bioavailability of poorly soluble drugs, but identifying high-performing formulations remains experimentally intensive. We present Andromeda 2, an agentic system that reasons over structured in-house experimental evidence and invokes computational and experimental tools to design and execute successive formulation batches. Using a miniaturized automated laboratory at a matched budget, we benchmark it against Andromeda 1, a probabilistic optimization model deployed across dozens of live development projects, and a wet-lab design-of-experiments (DoE) campaign. For paclitaxel, Andromeda 2 achieved a 50% high-performance hit rate versus 17% for Andromeda 1 and 2% for DoE, and identified 12 formulations meeting all four target product profile (TPP) objectives versus 6 and 0, respectively. Median $AUC_{10-240}$ was 70.1, 12.0, and 3.5 mg$\cdot$min/mL, while maximum AUC was comparable between Andromeda 2 and Andromeda 1. A selected full-TPP formulation achieved an apparent effective paclitaxel loading of $19 \pm 5\%$ w/w at the first FaSSIF measurement, approximately 3.3-fold higher than the 5.7% w/w loading reported for a published paclitaxel S-SEDDS. A controlled ablation showed that access to structured in-house experimental evidence increased mean AUC by 34%.
summary_zh: 自乳化给药系统（Self-emulsifying drug delivery systems, SEDDS）可提升难溶性药物的口服生物利用度，但筛选高性能配方仍需大量实验工作。本文提出Andromeda 2这一智能体系统，可基于结构化的内部实验证据进行推理，调用计算与实验工具设计并执行连续的配方批次。在预算匹配的小型化自动化实验室环境中，我们将其与已在数十个实际开发项目中部署的概率优化模型Andromeda 1、以及湿实验室实验设计（design-of-experiments, DoE）方案进行基准对比。针对紫杉醇配方开发任务，Andromeda 2的高性能命中率达50%，而Andromeda 1和DoE分别仅为17%和2%；Andromeda 2筛选出12种满足全部4项目标产品概况（target product profile, TPP）要求的配方，后两者分别仅为6种和0种。三组实验的中位AUC₁₀₋₂₄₀值分别为70.1、12.0和3.5 mg·min/mL，Andromeda 2与Andromeda 1的最大AUC值相当。筛选出的一款满足全部TPP要求的配方，在首次空腹模拟肠液（FaSSIF）测试中实现了19±5% w/w的表观有效紫杉醇载药量，约为已发表的紫杉醇S-SEDDS配方载药量（5.7% w/w）的3.3倍。受控消融实验表明，访问结构化内部实验证据可将平均AUC值提升34%。

title: A General Kernel Framework for Non-CND Distance Measures Using |D|-Dimensional Sparse Landmark Embeddings
title_zh: 基于|D|维稀疏地标嵌入的非条件负定距离度量通用核框架
authors: Marcus M. Noack, Maher B. Alghalayini, Mark D. Risser
abstract: Kernel methods, and Gaussian Processes (GPs) in particular, require a Hilbertian distance measure---one whose square is conditionally negative definite (CND)---to guarantee positive semi-definiteness (PSD) of the kernel matrix; a condition that fails for many natural input spaces, including smooth manifolds and spaces of probability distributions. We propose the Sparse Landmark Embedding (SLE) kernel, which eliminates this requirement entirely. Each input is embedded into a sparse feature vector via compactly supported bump functions centered at all |D| training points; applying any standard PSD kernel in this embedding space yields a kernel that is provably PSD for arbitrary distance measures. The compact support automatically controls embedding sparsity, keeping kernel matrices well-conditioned and computationally tractable despite the high ambient dimension. We provide theoretical guarantees on PSD, sparsity, stability, and universal approximation, and demonstrate, using geodesic and Wasserstein distances, that the SLE kernel matches or substantially exceeds domain-specific baselines in both predictive accuracy and uncertainty quantification.
summary_zh: 核方法（尤其是高斯过程（Gaussian Processes, GPs））要求使用希尔伯特距离度量——即距离平方为条件负定（conditionally negative definite, CND）的度量，才能保证核矩阵的半正定性（positive semi-definiteness, PSD）；但该条件对大量自然输入空间（包括光滑流形、概率分布空间）均不成立。本文提出稀疏地标嵌入（Sparse Landmark Embedding, SLE）核，可完全摆脱上述条件限制。每个输入通过以全部|D|个训练点为中心的紧支撑 bump 函数嵌入为稀疏特征向量，在该嵌入空间中应用任意标准半正定核，即可得到对任意距离度量都可证为半正定的核。紧支撑特性可自动控制嵌入稀疏度，即便环境维度很高也能保证核矩阵的良态性与计算可行性。本文从理论层面证明了该方法的半正定性、稀疏性、稳定性与通用逼近性保障，并基于测地距离与Wasserstein距离开展实验，结果表明SLE核在预测精度与不确定性量化方面的表现均匹配或大幅超过领域专用基线方法。

title: Safety-Flag: A Unified Benchmark for the Reliability and Calibration of LLM Content Moderators
title_zh: Safety-Flag：面向大语言模型内容审核器可靠性与校准的统一基准
authors: Yibo Hu
abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for content moderation, but most evaluations still report aggregate accuracy on individual benchmarks. We introduce Safety-Flag, which places seven widely used safety benchmarks (BeaverTails, XSTest, Ethics, WildGuard, Aegis, ToxiChat, and ToxiGen) into a single balanced flag / do-not-flag protocol. We release item-level decisions and confidence scores for six general-purpose LLMs and four dedicated guards, together with three reference models, evaluated on the same items. Safety-Flag measures three dimensions of moderator reliability: error direction, probability calibration, and confidence-based error ranking for human review. They often disagree. Aggregate accuracy does not reveal error direction: one model flags $85\%$ of benign content, whereas another misses $54\%$ of harmful content. All six general-purpose models are overconfident; fitting one temperature per model reduces calibration error by $2.8$--$6.0\times$ without changing predicted labels or confidence ordering. Confidence-based abstention lowers selective risk for every model, although the gains depend on how well confidence ranks errors. Dedicated guards produce fewer false alarms and are better calibrated, but several have higher miss rates outside their documented coverage. We release the benchmark, fixed item lists, evaluation code, per-item model outputs, and leaderboard at: https://github.com/yibo-hu-lab/safety-flag-benchmark.
summary_zh: 大语言模型正越来越多地应用于内容审核场景，但现有大多数评估仅报告单个基准上的总体准确率。本文提出Safety-Flag基准，将7个广泛使用的安全基准（BeaverTails、XSTest、Ethics、WildGuard、Aegis、ToxiChat、ToxiGen）整合到统一的平衡化「标记/不标记」协议中。我们公开了6款通用大语言模型、4款专用防护模型以及3款参考模型在相同测试集上的逐样本决策结果与置信度得分。Safety-Flag从三个维度衡量审核器的可靠性：错误方向、概率校准、面向人工审核的基于置信度的错误排序。实验发现不同模型的表现存在显著差异：总体准确率无法反映错误方向，例如某款模型将85%的良性内容误标记为违规，而另一款模型漏检了54%的有害内容。所有6款通用大语言模型均存在过度自信问题，为每个模型拟合单独的温度系数可将校准误差降低2.8~6.0倍，且不会改变预测标签或置信度排序。基于置信度的弃权机制可降低所有模型的选择性风险，但其提升幅度取决于置信度对错误的排序能力。专用防护模型的误报率更低、校准效果更好，但部分模型在其公开覆盖范围之外的场景下漏检率更高。我们已公开该基准、固定样本列表、评估代码、逐样本模型输出与排行榜，访问地址为：https://github.com/yibo-hu-lab/safety-flag-benchmark。

title: LightSleepX: A Lightweight, Inception-Based Dual-Modal Network for Sleep Staging
title_zh: LightSleepX：基于Inception架构的轻量级双模态睡眠分期网络
authors: Yi Wang
abstract: Automatic sleep staging is fundamental to personal health monitoring, yet many existing approaches are ill-suited for real-world applications. Traditional pipelines often rely on hand-crafted features or shallow machine learning models that struggle to generalize, while state-of-the-art deep learning methods, though accurate, are computationally heavy and impractical for resource-constrained environments. This paper introduces LightSleepX, a lightweight framework designed to deliver robust sleep analysis in resource-constrained environments. LightSleepX combines an Inception-style architecture with depthwise separable convolutions and Multi-scale Enhanced Attention for efficient multi-modal EEG/EOG feature extraction, and a Mamba encoder for rule-free long-range temporal modeling. On public benchmark datasets, LightSleepX achieves 85.9% accuracy and a 0.803 macro-F1 score on Sleep-EDF-20, and 81.8% accuracy and a 0.796 macro-F1 score on the cross-subject ISRUC-S3 dataset. With 0.049M parameters and 195.9 MFLOPs, the framework targets practical local deployment where computational cost and privacy are central constraints.
summary_zh: 自动睡眠分期是个人健康监测的基础技术，但现有多数方法难以适配实际应用场景。传统技术路线通常依赖人工设计特征或浅层机器学习模型，泛化能力不足；当前性能最优的深度学习方法虽然精度高，但计算量过大，难以在资源受限环境中部署。本文提出LightSleepX这一轻量级框架，可在资源受限环境下实现鲁棒的睡眠分析。LightSleepX融合了Inception风格架构、深度可分离卷积与多尺度增强注意力机制，实现高效的双模态脑电图（EEG）/眼电图（EOG）特征提取，同时采用Mamba编码器实现无规则依赖的长距离时序建模。在公开基准数据集上，LightSleepX在Sleep-EDF-20数据集上的准确率达85.9%，宏F1值达0.803；在跨受试者的ISRUC-S3数据集上准确率达81.8%，宏F1值达0.796。该框架仅含0.049M参数，计算量仅为195.9 MFLOPs，可面向计算成本与隐私为核心约束的实际本地部署场景。

title: Integrated Optimization of Automated Warehouse Operations and Last-Mile Transport for Differentiated On-Demand Delivery
title_zh: 面向差异化按需配送的自动仓库运营与最后一公里运输集成优化
authors: Xiaozhu Sun, Bilal Farooq
abstract: In the context of differentiated on-demand goods delivery services, this study proposes an integrated optimization method for automated guided vehicles (AGVs) based smart warehouse operations and the last-mile multi-modal transport. A deep reinforcement learning algorithm for multi-objective joint scheduling is designed to establish a dynamic connection between two systems, solving key challenges such as achieving high-throughput continuous order scheduling, meeting competing requirements, and improving the overall system sensitivity and adaptability. For warehouse optimization within this framework, we propose an improved algorithm based on multi-objective, Multi-Reward Machines-A* Guided Deep Q-Network (MORM-AGDQN), which combines service level, system cost, and external transportation demand. For external optimization, we propose an improved algorithm based on a Multi-Reward, Multi Head attention-Heterogeneous Capacity Vehicle Routing Problem (MRMH-HCVRP) framework, which incorporates the optimized scheduling order sequence and grouping, combined with customer location, demand, and priority, vehicle capacity, speed, and service range. The results show that the proposed framework significantly outperforms traditional methods, achieving 100% on-time delivery rate for warehousing operations. After joint optimization, the average delivery time for the last mile was reduced by 29.3% to 53.2%, the total transportation distance was reduced by 46.4%, the high-priority service rate was increased to over 92%, and a balance was maintained between operating costs and customer satisfaction.
summary_zh: 针对差异化按需商品配送服务场景，本文提出面向基于自动导引车（Automated Guided Vehicle, AGV）的智能仓库运营与最后一公里多模式运输的集成优化方法。设计了面向多目标联合调度的深度强化学习算法，在两个系统之间建立动态关联，解决高吞吐连续订单调度、满足多冲突需求、提升系统整体灵敏度与适应性等核心挑战。在该框架的仓库优化模块，本文提出融合服务水平、系统成本与外部运输需求的改进算法：基于多奖励机器A*引导的深度Q网络（Multi-Reward Machines-A* Guided Deep Q-Network, MORM-AGDQN）。在外部优化模块，本文提出融合优化后调度订单序列与分组、结合客户位置/需求/优先级、车辆容量/速度/服务范围的改进算法：基于多奖励多头注意力的异构容量车辆路径问题（Multi-Reward, Multi Head attention-Heterogeneous Capacity Vehicle Routing Problem, MRMH-HCVRP）框架。实验结果表明，所提框架的表现显著优于传统方法，仓库运营的准时交付率达100%；联合优化后，最后一公里平均配送时长降低29.3%~53.2%，总运输距离降低46.4%，高优先级服务率提升至92%以上，实现了运营成本与客户满意度的平衡。

title: LSR-Net: Learning the Forward Evolution Operator for Nonlinear Fluid Dynamics
title_zh: LSR-Net：用于非线性流体动力学的前向演化算子学习网络
authors: Qian Hou,  Sutrisno, Yuqing Li, Zecheng Gan
abstract: We introduce the Long-Short-Range Neural Network (LSR-Net), a novel neural operator architecture designed for data-driven forward evolution modeling, and extends it to the prediction of nonlinear fluid dynamics. LSR-Net learns the evolution operator of a dynamical system solely from pairs of initial and future state snapshots, which splits the learnable integral kernel into long-range (LR) and short-range (SR) components within stacked network blocks. While the SR component uses standard convolutions to capture local dynamics, the LR component employs a sum-of-exponentials (SOE) representation. This allows for the efficient computation of global interactions as a trainable Fourier multiplier, reducing computational complexity to $O(n \log n)$ where $n$ is the number of pixels in an input snapshot and requiring only a few parameters per channel. LSR-Net is evaluated on three challenging 2D benchmarks: the coupled Burgers equation, the wave equation with a spatially varying coefficient, and the nonlinear shallow water equation {(SWE)}.
